description:
What's the difference between legal and experiential justification in the Bible? Join Pastor Stephen Bohr and the SUMtv panel as they explore this key Christian doctrine. In this episode of “I’d Like to Know,” we explain the biblical foundations of justification and how it relates to salvation, grace, and faith.
🙏✨ Send us your questions at tv@sumtv.org, and they might be featured in an upcoming episode!

⏰ Join Us Live Every Tuesday at 4:30 PM (Pacific Time)
Tune in to SUMtv.org for our live studio Q&A, where we explore the Bible and answer your questions with the spirit of prophecy and truth!
